1 learning rate too big.symptom: loss 1.565 (ln 5 = 1.609), val acc 0.187, 99.6% dead neurons in layer 2; SGD lr 1: nan at mini-batch 8
1 learning rate too big.cause: steps too big: they push the ReLU neurons of layer 2 below 0 for every image (dead), or blow up the weights
1 learning rate too big.after cure: best val acc 0.438, 0.4% dead neurons in layer 2

2 zero_grad forgotten.symptom: loss jumps up to 4.94, then val acc 0.192 (one class); gradient norm x26 after 2 epochs
2 zero_grad forgotten.cause: PyTorch adds each new gradient to the old ones: every step uses the sum of all past gradients
2 zero_grad forgotten.after cure: loss falls smoothly to 1.068, val acc 0.411

3 raw pixels.symptom: first loss 16.3 instead of 1.6; SGD loss up to 3.1e+08; Adam noisy, best val acc 0.352
3 raw pixels.cause: inputs up to 255 make huge pre-activations and logits, so huge losses and gradients
3 raw pixels.cure: standardise each channel with the training mean and std

4 deep sigmoid.symptom: loss stuck at 1.609 = ln 5, val acc 0.196; gradient of layer 1 / layer 9 = 6e-07
4 deep sigmoid.cause: vanishing gradient: the sigmoid derivative is at most 1/4, multiplied over 8 layers
4 deep sigmoid.after cure: layer 1 / layer 9 = 0.17, loss 0.296, best val acc 0.393
